summary: A Business Bay law firm appears to lose enquiries to a 2017 blog post as the homepage, a typo in the title and links that go nowhere.

findings.problem: The page title appears to read SM Law Firm-Best lawer in Dubai, with lawer misspelled.
findings.cost: A typo in the first thing a searcher sees weakens trust in a law firm.
findings.fix: A proofread title with the firm name and practice.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to be a blog post dated 10/7/2017 rather than a firm introduction.
findings.cost: Clients landing on an old post cannot see practice areas, lawyers or how to hire you.
findings.fix: A real homepage with services, lawyers and a consultation button.

findings.problem: Read Now and Share links appear to point to #.
findings.cost: Dead links stop readers who want to go further.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Weebly address, and no WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: A free builder address looks temporary and clients cannot message quickly.
findings.fix: Your own domain and WhatsApp on every page.
